# michi-vz

<!-- Generated file. Edit apps/docs/scripts/llms/llms.template.txt and run `npm run generate-llms`. -->

> Framework-agnostic charting for the web: a plain TypeScript engine, light-DOM web components, and first-class React, Vue, Svelte, and Angular wrappers. {{chartCount}} chart types, svg and canvas renderers, a structured ChartContext on every chart for accessibility and tool use, and an opt-in, local-first insights layer for forecasting, anomaly detection, narration, agents, and MCP.

Package versions: @michi-vz/core {{version:@michi-vz/core}}, wc {{version:@michi-vz/wc}}, react {{version:@michi-vz/react}}, vue {{version:@michi-vz/vue}}, svelte {{version:@michi-vz/svelte}}, angular {{version:@michi-vz/angular}}, insights {{version:@michi-vz/insights}}, devtools {{version:@michi-vz/devtools}}.
